name: ClickUp
description: Project management: all-in-one productivity platform for tasks, docs, goals, chat and time tracking.
access_notes: API is available on all ClickUp plans including Free Forever; anyone with an account can generate a personal API token (pk_...), and workspace owners/admins can create OAuth apps self-serve in workspace settings. Rate limit 100 req/min per token on standard plans.
mcp_notes: Official ClickUp-hosted MCP server at https://mcp.clickup.com/mcp (public beta, all plans, OAuth-only auth) documented at developer.clickup.com. Composio also has a CLICKUP toolkit (docs.composio.dev/toolkits/clickup).
uncertainty_notes: MCP server is public beta; without the Everything AI add-on MCP calls are limited (50/day free, 300/day paid). REST API itself has normal limits.

evidence.note: Personal API token (pk_, raw Authorization header) for personal use; OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow (token URL api.clickup.com/api/v2/oauth/token) for apps.
'The ClickUp API is available on all ClickUp plans'; anyone with an account can generate a personal token; owners/admins create OAuth apps.
Webhooks created via Create Webhook endpoint, signed with a shared secret, subscribing to task/list/folder/space/goal events.
Official ClickUp MCP server at https://mcp.clickup.com/mcp, public beta, available on all plans.
ClickUp help center confirms the official MCP server, OAuth-only auth and plan-based rate limits.
